description: This Java source file defines the ModuleCache class, which manages caching and retrieval of module information, including initialization, lookup by directory or name, and storage of modules.

classes.name: ModuleCache
classes.description: A singleton class that caches modules, allowing initialization, retrieval by directory or name, and management of module instances.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ModuleCache.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a given index file and builds the indexes.

methods.name: getAndCacheByDir
methods.description: Retrieves a module by directory, creating and caching it if necessary.

methods.name: getAndCacheByName
methods.description: Retrieves a module by name, locating its makefile and caching the module.

methods.name: putModule
methods.description: Stores a module in the cache with its canonical directory path.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves a module from the cache by its canonical directory path.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Returns an iterable of all cached modules.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a module to the cache.
